name: studio
description: Narrated, animated videos built around a learning goal, recorded evidence and fresh reviews. Polished by default: a beat sheet times picture and sound to the frame, polish is a planned stage judged on frame sequences, recorded CC0 effects land on their transient and are checked against the picture, and the voice pauses where an idea ends. Build in the background, with handoffs and hard stops, or follow along on the desk. Replaces tutor.
